selector.rationale: The presence of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels and superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels, along with the identification of the KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation, supports the diagnosis of Angiosarcoma.
